canonical_name: Local Langlands correspondence for GL_n over p-adic fields
canonical_statement: For every finite extension F of Q_p and every integer n >= 1, there is a uniquely normalized bijection from isomorphism classes of irreducible admissible smooth complex representations of GL_n(F) to equivalence classes of n-dimensional Frobenius-semisimple complex Weil-Deligne representations of W_F, compatible with local class field theory for n = 1, twists, contragredients, central characters, and local L- and epsilon-factors.
domain_and_universes: p a prime; F a non-archimedean local field restricted here to a finite extension of Q_p; n : Nat with 1 <= n; complex smooth representations and complex Weil-Deligne representations; exact Lean universes remain to be fixed
quantifiers: for every finite extension F / Q_p
for every n : Nat with 1 <= n
hypotheses: F is a finite extension of Q_p with its non-archimedean topology
representation-side objects are irreducible, admissible, smooth, and complex
parameter-side objects are n-dimensional, continuous, and Frobenius-semisimple Weil-Deligne representations
conclusion: A uniquely normalized bijection of the stated isomorphism/equivalence classes satisfying the listed compatibility laws exists.

alternate_encodings.target: continuous semisimple representations of the Weil group with nilpotent monodromy
alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate equivalent presentation of Weil-Deligne parameters

excluded_degenerate_cases: n = 0 is excluded. The n = 1 case is included as the local-class-field-theory normalization. Archimedean fields, positive-characteristic local fields, and groups other than GL_n are excluded from this frozen root.
